title: Steam Deck Front Cover - 2 Parts - A1 mini
author: MorastBlitz
description:
I love the Steam Deck Cover, but sadly I have only an A1 mini and the model ist too big.

So I splitted it in two parts and added the Steam Deck Logo to the middle.

With that I was able to place two 5x2 mangnets on each side.

It fits very well and with the magnets it does not even fall off when I carry it in my bag.

Be careful when removing the brim, I removed too much and now theres is a gap between to two parts!
